_comment: Transcribed from the in-game customisation screens, captured 2026-08-06 (Steam captures 20260806011221-011900 and 023313-023457). name: Heavy Extended Barrel

description.text: Long heavy barrel that increases projectile velocity and improves accuracy during sustained fire at the cost of weapon draw speed.
